relations.rationale: Finn being in Jun's class has no bearing on when Rosa arrived.
Finn being in the same class as Jun does not determine whether Rosa is in that class or not.
Finn's class membership with Jun has no connection to Finn and Gia playing a blitz match.
Rosa arriving a few minutes after Jun does not indicate whether she shares his class or not.
Rosa's apology for a late bus has no relation to Hugo learning the Sicilian Defense from Finn.
Rosa's class membership relative to Jun is unrelated to Hugo's height being noticeable in photos.
Rosa not being in Jun's class doesn't affect whether she teases him about his tournament ranking.
Hugo being the tallest directly supports the claim that this becomes obvious in group photos.
Hugo's height being obvious in photos has nothing to do with the room's smell.
Gia and Finn playing a blitz match while waiting sets up the context in which Gia could have won two of three games.
Gia and Finn playing chess while waiting for others has no bearing on Hugo being the newest member.

Gia and Finn practicing a blitz match while waiting is a separate activity from Finn explaining the Sicilian Defense over hot chocolate, though both involve Finn and chess-related activity, they don't necessarily connect.
Jun's high ranking in the tournament provides a basis for Rosa's continued teasing about that result.
Hugo being the newest member supports the idea that he would need to quickly learn chess concepts like the Sicilian Defense from others.
Hugo picking up the Sicilian Defense from Finn aligns with and supports the claim that Finn explained it patiently to him.
Everyone agreeing the room smelled pleasantly of chalk and old wood supports Gia's specific noting of that same pleasant smell.
